preconditions.expression: all(c in '01' for c in stdin.splitlines()[0]) and all(c in '01' for c in stdin.splitlines()[1])
preconditions.description: Both input strings a and b consist only of characters '0' and '1'.
Both input strings a and b are non-empty.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == 'YES' if (len(a) == len(b) and all((a[i] == b[i]) or (a[i] == '1' and a[j] == '1' and b[i] == '0' and b[j] == '1') or (a[i] == '0' and a[j] == '0' and b[i] == '1' and b[j] == '0') for i in range(len(a)-1) for j in range(i+1, len(a))) or len(a) == 1) else 'NO'
postconditions.description: Output 'YES' if and only if string a can be transformed into string b using the described operations. This holds if either (1) a and b are identical, (2) a and b have the same length and differ only in adjacent pairs where one is '11' and the other is '01' or '10', or (3) a and b are of length 1 (no operations possible).
